sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_profile" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "alias" TEXT NOT NULL, "birth_date" TEXT NULL, "sex" TEXT NULL, "height_cm" REAL NOT NULL, "experience_level" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal" TEXT NOT NULL, "days_per_week" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("days_per_week" BETWEEN 1 AND 7), "session_duration_min" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("session_duration_min" > 0), "equipment" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "body_weight_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL CHECK("weight_kg" > 0.0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "body_measurements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "waist_cm" REAL NULL, "chest_cm" REAL NULL, "arm_cm" REAL NULL, "leg_cm" REAL NULL, "hip_cm" REAL NULL, "body_fat_pct" REAL NULL CHECK("body_fat_pct" BETWEEN 0.0 AND 100.0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "primary_muscle" TEXT NOT NULL, "secondary_muscles" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "equipment" TEXT NOT NULL, "difficulty" TEXT NOT NULL, "instructions" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "common_mistakes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "image_path" TEXT NULL, "preferred_unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'kg', "is_custom" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_custom" IN (0, 1)), "is_seed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_seed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "template_type" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routine_days" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "routine_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES routines (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weekday" INTEGER NULL CHECK("weekday" BETWEEN 1 AND 7), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routine_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "routine_day_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES routine_days (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_sets" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("target_sets" > 0), "target_reps_min" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("target_reps_min" > 0), "target_reps_max" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("target_reps_max" >= "target_reps_min"), "initial_weight_kg" REAL NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("rest_seconds" >= 0), "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "routine_day_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES routine_days (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ended_at" TEXT NULL, "paused_total_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("paused_total_seconds" >= 0), "paused_at" TEXT NULL, "rest_ends_at" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inProgress', "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "is_demo" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_demo" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_sets" INTEGER NULL CHECK("target_sets" > 0), "target_reps_min" INTEGER NULL CHECK("target_reps_min" > 0), "target_reps_max" INTEGER NULL CHECK("target_reps_max" >= "target_reps_min"), "rest_seconds" INTEGER NULL CHECK("rest_seconds" >= 0), "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "set_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session_exercises (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "set_number" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("set_number" > 0), "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0 CHECK("weight_kg" >= 0.0), "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("reps" >= 0), "rir" INTEGER NULL CHECK("rir" >= 0), "is_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_completed" IN (0, 1)), "completed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
